items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: He used to tell me how to warm my lip... And he used to make me take corks and put them between my fingers... He could do that good though.

ctx.x: and all that that you know. And I couldn't get this note. That's not what I couldn't get. It took me a long time to get that note. Whatever the scales come from you know. But I couldn't get this. I kept on feeling till I come and loosen up on my lip you know and
you got that little note. But what I'm getting at is you can make a note like. No no just with your lip what kind of noise do you make? Who taught you that? Jim Horowitz. What did you do before that?

Well I don't know just go on blow. He used to tell me how to warm my lip and fuck up together like that. And he used to make me take corks and put them between my fingers and go like that you know about maybe half an hour or an hour. And make your finger limber too brother. Put corks between them like that. Slap a cork you know. He could do that good though. He could take his mouthpiece boy and just play. You know what I mean. Like you play something. And it would sound good? Yeah man. He used to play a tune on…
